d:
Enjoy The Evergreen Kannada Melody “Neenaade Baalige Jyothi” In Lyrical Song Format From The Classic Kannada Movie Hosa Belaku, Starring Dr. Rajkumar And Saritha. With Memorable Music Composed By M. Ranga Rao, This Timeless Song Celebrates The Golden Era Of Kannada Cinema.
Sing Along With This Beautiful Classic And Relive The Magic Of Evergreen Kannada Music.
Kannada Lyrical Songs, Classic Hits, And Evergreen Melodies.
Directed by: Dorai - Bhagwan
Produced by: S. A. Srinivas, Sadanand, Rajashekar, Shivaram
Written by: Chi. Udaya Shankar (dialogues)
